name: Cross-Device Cross-OS Web Animation Benchmark
description: Measures performance, visual fidelity, and cross-platform compatibility of modern web animation systems across devices and operating systems.
evaluation_method: Automated performance metrics (FPS, frame drops), visual fidelity metrics (pixel difference, SSIM, LPIPS) and compatibility pass/fail tests
general_score_metric: composite_score combining FPS stability, visual‑fidelity, and compatibility pass rate
reputation: Niche benchmark used mainly by HCI and web‑engineering researchers with limited adoption in ML communities.
notes: Results are hardware/browser dependent and non‑deterministic across runs; not an ML/LLM benchmark; sensitive to device and OS variability.
